key.name: profiles
key.summary: Saved profiles
key.description: JSON array of profiles. Each profile stores a wallpaper and optional appearance settings; null fields are left unchanged when the profile is applied.

key.name: active-profile
key.summary: ID of the profile that was applied last

key.name: first-run-done
key.summary: Whether the “Original” profile has been created

key.name: migrated-from-bg-changer
key.summary: Whether data of the BG Changer extension has been taken over

key.name: transition
key.summary: Wallpaper transition
key.description: “circle” reveals the new wallpaper with a growing circle, “fade” keeps GNOME's own crossfade.

key.name: transition-duration
key.summary: Duration of the circle transition in milliseconds

key.name: show-indicator
key.summary: Show the button in the top bar

key.name: atelier-open-switcher
key.summary: Open the profile switcher

key.name: atelier-open-wallpapers
key.summary: Open the switcher on the Wallpapers tab

key.name: wallpaper-folder
key.summary: Folder shown on the Wallpapers tab
key.description: Empty means ~/Pictures/Wallpapers, which is created when needed.

key.name: atelier-next-profile
key.summary: Apply the next profile

key.name: atelier-previous-profile
key.summary: Apply the previous profile

key.name: gtk4-link
key.summary: GTK 4 links made by BG Changer
key.description: JSON object listing the symlinks in ~/.config/gtk-4.0 that BG Changer created. Atelier replaces them with a generated stylesheet and then clears this key.

key.name: gtk4-theme
key.summary: Theme imported for GTK 4 apps
key.description: Directory of the GTK theme whose GTK 4 stylesheet is imported into ~/.config/gtk-4.0/gtk.css, or empty. Set when a profile with GTK 4 theming is applied.

key.name: gtk-css-problem
key.summary: Why the GTK stylesheets could not be written, if they couldn't

key.name: apply-request
key.summary: Request from the preferences to apply a profile
key.description: JSON object with the profile ID and a nonce. Written by the preferences window, handled by the shell.

key.name: source
key.summary: Where the palette comes from
key.description: “wallpaper” picks the most fitting color of the wallpaper, “swatch” uses the chosen swatch of the wallpaper, “preset” uses a fixed palette.

key.name: swatch
key.summary: Swatch of the wallpaper used when the source is “swatch”

key.name: preset
key.summary: Fixed palette used when the source is “preset”

key.name: variant
key.summary: How colorful the palette is

key.name: gtk-apps
key.summary: Color GTK apps with the palette

key.name: terminal
key.summary: Color GNOME Terminal with the palette

key.name: terminal-profile
key.summary: GNOME Terminal profile created by Atelier

key.name: terminal-previous-default
key.summary: GNOME Terminal profile that was the default before Atelier's

key.name: current
key.summary: The palette in use (JSON), written by the shell

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Show the island in the middle of the top bar
key.description: The island takes the place of GNOME's clock: it shows the time, grows into a glance on hover and hosts the switcher, the power menu, notifications, profile toasts and the control centre, which opens when it is clicked.

key.name: show-date
key.summary: Show the date next to the time

key.name: glance-on-hover
key.summary: Show the glance while the pointer rests on the island
key.description: A big clock, this week, what's left of today's events and the weather.

key.name: profile-toast
key.summary: Show the profile's name in the island when switching to it

key.name: atelier-power-menu
key.summary: Open the power menu in the island

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Show notifications in the island
key.description: Banners appear in the island instead of under the top bar. GNOME still decides which notifications show (Do Not Disturb, per-app settings, the queue), and they stay in the notification list.

key.name: app-buttons
key.summary: Buttons of notifications, per app
key.description: JSON object mapping GNOME's notification app keys (e.g. "org-gnome-nautilus") to "app" (the app's own buttons, the default), "none" or "reply-mute". WhatsApp as a Chrome app gets Reply and Mute, Claude none.

key.name: muted
key.summary: Muted apps
key.description: JSON object mapping app keys to the end of the mute in Unix seconds, or 0 until it is lifted. Notifications of muted apps go to the list without a banner.

key.name: enabled
key.summary: Open the control centre in the island
key.description: Clicking the island (or Super+S) opens a control centre with GNOME's quick settings – Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, sliders, power mode, tiles of extensions – and, on further tabs, GNOME's notification list (Super+V) and calendar, instead of GNOME's menus. The status icons in the top bar only show the state.

key.name: extensions
key.summary: Move extension icons into the control centre
key.description: Icons that extensions put into the top bar move to the control centre's Extensions tab. The bar keeps the workspaces, the island, the status icons and the screen sharing and recording indicators.

key.name: style
key.summary: Look of the top bar
key.description: “grouped” puts the workspaces, the island and the status icons together in the middle, “spread” the workspaces at the left edge and the status icons at the right one, “island” all of them into one island. None of them has a background of its own. “gnome” keeps GNOME's black bar.

key.name: compact
key.summary: Only the essentials in the middle
key.description: Grouped and as one island, the bar shows only the workspaces, the time and the battery (and the screen recording and sharing indicators while they are on). The control centre has everything else.

key.name: sides
key.summary: Where the workspaces and the status icons lie
key.description: “wallpaper” right on the wallpaper, “capsules” in capsules like the island. (In the “island” style, they are in the island.)

key.name: surface
key.summary: What the island and the capsules are made of
key.description: “classic” is black, “glass” the blurred wallpaper.

key.name: modules
key.summary: Modules on the right of the top bar
key.description: “claude” (Claude Code's usage in this 5-hour block) and “weather”. They only show something; resting the pointer on one shows its details in the island.

key.name: island-shape
key.summary: Shape of the island
key.description: “floating” is a capsule in the bar, “notch” hangs from the top edge of the screen.
